description: This file provides functions to interact with WebPA protocol parameters, including getting and setting parameters and attributes, as well as retrieving parameter names. It acts as a client-side API wrapper for WebPA operations, with support for mock mode responses.

methods.name: webpaGetParameter({ deviceId, parameter })
methods.description: Fetches a WebPA parameter value, either mocked or via an API POST request.

methods.name: webpaSetParameter({ deviceId, parameter, value, dataType = 'string' })
methods.description: Sets a WebPA parameter value, either mocked or via an API POST request.

methods.name: webpaGetAttributes({ deviceId, parameter })
methods.description: Retrieves WebPA parameter attributes, either mocked or via an API POST request.

methods.name: webpaSetAttributes({ deviceId, parameter, attributes })
methods.description: Sets WebPA parameter attributes, either mocked or via an API POST request.

methods.name: webpaGetParameterNames({ deviceId, path, nextLevel = false })
methods.description: Gets WebPA parameter names under a specified path, either mocked or via an API POST request.

ctags.name: webpaGetParameterNames
ctags.pattern: /^export async function webpaGetParameterNames({ deviceId, path, nextLevel = false }) {$/

ctags.name: webpaSetAttributes
ctags.pattern: /^export async function webpaSetAttributes({ deviceId, parameter, attributes }) {$/

ctags.name: webpaSetParameter
ctags.pattern: /^export async function webpaSetParameter({ deviceId, parameter, value, dataType = 'string' }) {$/
